word: _*wa*_ 'ow presumed to be the "constructive" or genitival form of _*wa*_ 'av
avSummary: also, and, desire, either, least, nor, or, otherwise, should, then, whether
definition:
1) or, rather
    1a) implying that the latter choice is preferred
    1b) or if, introducing an example to be seen under a particular principle
    1c) (in series) either...or, whether...or
    1d) if perchance
    1e) except, or else
 2) whether, not the least, if, otherwise, also, and, then
